[SWS_TS_00427]
{DRAFT}
⌈
After the current
Pdelay
measurement is finished, i.e.,
upon transmission of the
Pdelay_Resp_Follow_Up
, all parameters defined by
ara::tsync::PdelayResponderMeasurementType
shall be updated and the
function
ara::tsync::ProviderTimeBaseValidationNotification::Set-
PdelayResponderData
shall be invoked.
⌋
